title: AI Gateway now supports Private Inference
summary:
Private Inference connects your own model endpoints to AI Gateway.

Enterprises running fine-tuned, self-hosted, or prerelease models used to need separate keys, client code, and logs for them. Those models can now run through the same authentication, SDKs and APIs, and observability as catalog models, so every model your team uses is managed in one place.

Use Private Inference to:

  • Switch between private and catalog models: Call private models through Chat Completions, Responses, or Messages. AI Gateway translates each request to your endpoint's format, so switching only changes the model ID.

title: Qwik 2.0 RC: Replaces HTML Comment Markers for Faster Reactivity and Out-of-Order Streaming
summary:
Qwik 2.0 Release Candidate, published on 1 October 2026, replaces v1's HTML comment markers with two script blocks that hold state and virtual node data. It adds experimental out-of-order streaming, async useComputed$, and cacheable route loaders. Qwik's benchmarks show v2 at 1.23x vanilla JavaScript, versus 2.59x for v1. A migration command is provided.

By Daniel Curtis

title: Presentation: Scaling LLM-Based Ranking Systems for Latency-Critical Search & Recommendation Workloads
summary:
Sundara Raman Ramachandran shares how LinkedIn productionizes LLM ranking under strict P99 latency SLAs. He discusses distilling a 7B model down to 400M parameters, compressing job contexts into single-token embeddings for a 10x throughput leap, and eliminating hidden system bottlenecks - from custom flash attention masks to Python GIL workarounds, gc.freeze, and non-blocking CUDA memory copies.

By Sundara Raman Ramachandran

title: Ten Years On, Google Updates the SRE Book for the AI Era
summary:
Google has announced a completely rewritten second edition of Site Reliability Engineering: How Google Runs Production Systems, ten years after the original book was published by O'Reilly Media. The update reframes SRE around modern cloud architectures, platform engineering and AI workloads, while retaining the discipline's original emphasis on applying software engineering to operations.

By Matt Saunders

title: Microsoft Releases .NET 11: C# 15 Union Types, Native AOT CLI Host, and CoreCLR by Default in MAUI
summary:

By Almir Vuk
